title: Avoid simple join group aggregate name display allocation
description: Replace simple_join_group_aggregate_projection dispatch via func.name.to_string().to_uppercase() with direct ObjectNamePart matching.

criteria: Simple join group aggregate planning no longer builds uppercase display names before classifying supported functions
COUNT star, COUNT column, and SUM column join aggregate behavior remains unchanged
Qualified names remain rejected by the simple aggregate check

notes: The planner now maps supported function names to static accumulator names through direct ObjectNamePart comparisons.
The accumulator name String is allocated only after the function is recognized as supported.
COUNT and SUM argument rules remain unchanged.
